title: Voy A Builds The Future
voice_notes: Warm, patient teacher. One voice. Brian v3. English prompts use language_code en; Spanish reveals use language_code es. Avoid Language Transfer branding.

segments.say: Spanish gives you a future sentence without a new verb ending.
Voy can mean I go, or I am going.
segments.show:
voy = I go
I am going

segments.say: To say I am going to, Spanish uses voy a.
segments.show:
voy a =
I am going to

segments.say: After voy a, keep the next verb unchanged.
Say: I am going to continue.
Confiscation can give you confiscar. Add lo for it.
Now say: I am going to confiscate it.
segments.word: I am going to confiscate it

segments.say: Examination can give you examinar. Same shape.
Say: I am going to examine it.
segments.word: I am going to examine it

segments.say: Good. Voy a did the future work. The verb stayed in its to form.
segments.show:
voy a did
the future work

caption: Voy a means I am going to. Then keep the next verb unchanged: voy a continuar, voy a confiscarlo, voy a examinarlo.
